item.title: DEC Nature Notes: snowshoe hare
item.description: Known as the varying hare, the snowshoe hare changes color in the winter by developing a new outer coat of white fur. Triggered by changes in day length, the snowshoe hare gradually sheds its brown-gray coat and replaces it with a layer of longer white guard hairs.
